{{Commons cat|Community}}
'''[[Community]]''' is a broad topic with many subcategories and areas of interest. It is itself a subcategory of [[:Category:Sociology|Sociology]] expanding to include [[Community development]] informally known as [[:Category:Community building|Community building]], [[:Category:Community organizing|Community organizing]] and several others. Work is being conducted by [[Wikipedia:WikiProject Community|WikiProject Community]] and [[Wikipedia:WikiProject Categories|WikiProject Categories]] to better organize and [[Wikipedia:Categorization|categorize]] Wikipedia's articles relating to community topics. You are welcome to join these efforts.
